comment_regular: Verified per-reference seed read. Missing ExtraData_Seed yields index 0xFF, which calls TESObjectTREE_GetRandomSeed. If the tree seed array is empty, that fallback returns 0. Thus an empty array makes getter results 0 and concrete seed writes no-op; runtime array population outside the TREE record loader remains Unknown.
